scoringCalibration: One face point is earned because the lower-third silhouette now has a measured 3 mm jaw taper plus controlled malar, buccal, alar and nose-tip transitions. The face remains below review quality because eyelid thickness, oral topology and high-frequency anatomical forms are incomplete.
visualFindings: The lower face now tapers from the cheek into the jaw instead of retaining the previous broad cylindrical outline.
Sub-millimetre malar projection and buccal recession separate the cheekbone from the lower cheek in the three-quarter view.
The nose tip projects slightly farther while the alar region narrows, reducing the former rounded plug-like base.
The adjustments remain subtle enough to preserve the v30 eye and mouth placement and the v35 scalp transition.
rejectedExperiments: The first two v36 parameter passes were rejected because the jaw moved only 0.09-0.96 mm and produced no reliably visible silhouette improvement.
blockingFailures: Integrated eyelid thickness, canthus anatomy and a denser eyebrow groom remain below review quality.
A true mouth slit, oral cavity, teeth, tongue and expression-compatible lip topology are still missing.
The primary groom still needs hand-shaped large and medium clumps, a readable part, crown breakup and controlled side volume.
Clothing edge flow, seams, folds, materials and outer layers remain below review quality.
Raised-arm shoulders still require corrective deformation and the standard pose suite remains incomplete.
Signed clothing-distance samples remain negative despite zero exact triangle overlaps in the two audited frames.
LOD transition popping and frame-time impact remain untested in the website renderer.
